description: This file contains implementation of classes and methods related to parsing text and file paths within the Thunder::Core namespace, including TextParser and PathParser classes.

classes.name: TextParser
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing text fragments, with methods to read text based on delimiters.

classes.name: PathParser
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing file paths into drive, path, filename, extension, and base filename components.

methods.name: ReadText
methods.description: Reads text from the current position until a delimiter or quote is found, returning the endpoint position.

methods.name: ReadText (overload)
methods.description: Reads a text fragment into an OptionalType, updating the result with the parsed text.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a file path string into drive, path, filename, extension, and base filename components.
